label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today in Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on the biggest stories across golf today.

items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson
items.text: Si Woo Kim won at TPC Craig Ranch at 18-under, five shots clear of Sungjae Im, Kensei Hirata, Scottie Scheffler and Wyndham Clark at 13-under.

items.headline: Bryson rumor denied
items.text: Haotong Li denied mocking Bryson DeChambeau, posting on Instagram: “That’s a false rumor! I would never say something like that.”

items.headline: Higgo penalty fallout
items.text: Garrick Higgo’s caddie Austin Gaugert blamed himself for Higgo’s late PGA Championship tee time penalty, saying he “fell short” before the pair split.

items.headline: Golf internet
items.text: A giant r/golf bunker post turned into a rules debate because bunkers and waste areas are treated differently under the Rules of Golf.
